data.narrative:
Aepnus Technology is a Seed-stage company in the Climate & Energy sector, having raised $10.6M to date. The valuation universe comprises nine private peers (including Helion, Redwood Materials, QuantumScape, KoBold Metals, and Electric Hydrogen) and one public comparable (Lonza, ticker LNZA), though direct peer matching at the Seed stage within this sector proved constrained.

Stage-progression analysis is the applicable method here. Using total raised ($10.6M) as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, the analysis implies a valuation of $26.5M. A peer-median approach was not feasible due to insufficient same-stage and adjacent-stage comparables within the narrow Climate & Energy peer set—while nine sector peers exist, none met the filtering thresholds necessary for a reliable median calculation.

The triangulation range supported by this analysis is $23M to $30M, with a median of $26M. This reflects conservative application of stage-based progression without overweighting a sparse comparable set. Key uncertainties include the limited depth of same-stage private peer data in Climate & Energy, the composition of Aepnus's $10.6M raise across funding tranches, and the company's current burn rate relative to operational milestones that might justify step-up progression.
